description: Inspector agent and client: start, refused and accepted connections, ping, snapshot, events, previews
script: goto:pl-inspector;wait:20;press:Agent::Start;wait:5;press:Client::Connect with a wrong token;wait:5;press:Client::Connect with the token;wait:5;press:Client::Ping;wait:5;press:Client::CaptureSnapshot;wait:5;press:Client::ReadEvents;wait:5;press:Client::RequestPreview of a resource;wait:5;press:Client::RequestPreview of the room's own texture;wait:5;press:Client::PollPreview;wait:5;press:Agent::Stop;wait:5;press:Client::Ping;wait:5;stats;quit
expectRegex: \[museum\]\[inspector\] Client::PollPreview: ok, Ready 64x64 image/png, [0-9]+ bytes, PNG signature ok
